description: This Java source file defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot REST API. It centrally manages various exceptions such as not found, validation errors, malformed JSON, data integrity violations, and generic exceptions, converting them into standardized API error responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A centralized handler for managing exceptions thrown within a Spring Boot REST API, converting exceptions into standardized ApiError responses.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles NotFoundException by returning a 404 API error response.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors (MethodArgumentNotValidException), collects field errors, and returns a 400 response.

methods.name: handleNotReadable
methods.description: Handles malformed JSON requests (HttpMessageNotReadableException), returning a 400 response.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrity
methods.description: Handles data integrity violations (DataIntegrityViolationException), returning a 409 conflict response.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse
methods.description: Handles ErrorResponseException, extracting status and message to return an appropriate error response.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles any other unexpected exceptions, returning a 500 internal server error response.
